releases.name: Cloud SDK 2.2.71 managed lifecycle helpers
releases.body:
Cloud SDK 2.2.71 adds TypeScript and Python lifecycle/constraints projections and same-environment resume from authoritative state.

Published packages: `@prismer/sdk@2.2.71` and `@prismer/mcp-server@2.2.71` on official npm, and `prismer==2.2.71` on official PyPI. Registry integrity/SHA hashes match the attached validated artifacts. Fresh registry installation, public TypeScript main/subpath types, ESM/CJS loading, Cloud CLI help, and MCP stdio initialization/tool discovery passed.

Installed TypeScript, Python sync and Python async helper checks passed (15 cases, loopback HTTP). Real ACS cold journeys passed with the official installed npm SDK (22 checks) and PyPI SDK (21 checks), including execution, file hash roundtrip, active same-ID resume, legacy stopped resume rejection and temporary resource/key cleanup. These validate cold compatibility against the existing test service; they do not prove the pending service candidate was deployed.

Real managed save/reclaim/restore fidelity and automatic lease renewal remain unaccepted capabilities. No project managed lifecycle was enabled. Runtime 2.2.71 was already published and is not republished here.

releases.name: AIP 2.2.71
releases.body:
AIP 2.2.71 dependency release for Cloud SDK lifecycle helpers.

Published `@prismer/aip-sdk@2.2.71` on official npm and `prismer-aip==2.2.71` on official PyPI. Registry integrity/SHA hashes match the attached validated artifacts. Fresh registry installation and installed module import passed. No Runtime package is republished.

releases.name: Cloud SDK 2.2.69
releases.body: EaaS readiness waits fail fast for lifecycle states that require an explicit action. TypeScript and Python support sandbox readiness after wake and preserve bounded Retry-After polling. Candidate unit, package and installed artifact checks passed. Test backend deployment and full post-release regression are tracked separately; this release does not assert ACS gateway or checkpoint acceptance. No Runtime OTA release.
